sentences.en: Shall we meet tomorrow at eight?

passages.text: Oye, al final no puedo el sábado por la tarde, tengo que ayudar a mi hermano con la mudanza. ¿Te viene bien el domingo por la mañana? Podríamos ir al Rastro y luego tomar algo.
passages.en: Hey, in the end I can't do Saturday afternoon, I have to help my brother move house. Does Sunday morning work for you? We could go to the Rastro flea market and then have a drink.
passages.question: What does your friend want?
passages.answer: To move your plan from Saturday afternoon to Sunday morning.
wrong: Your help moving house on Sunday.
To cancel and not meet at all.
To meet on Saturday morning instead.

passages.text: Olha, afinal não posso no sábado à tarde, tenho de ajudar o meu irmão com a mudança. Dá-te jeito domingo de manhã? Podíamos ir à Feira da Ladra e depois beber qualquer coisa.
passages.en: Listen, in the end I can't do Saturday afternoon, I have to help my brother move house. Does Sunday morning suit you? We could go to the Feira da Ladra flea market and then have a drink.
passages.question: What does your friend want?
passages.answer: To move your plan from Saturday afternoon to Sunday morning.
